[instruction] a simple ALU simulator build with vim macro by ayazumi
[usage] please put in bin numbers after input 1 and 2, put options in optput, start by typing 5Gyy@0 in normal mode.
[manual] 04 for plusing, 23 for minus, 25 for +1, 22 for <<, 29 for arithmetic >>, 30 for logic >> (last 3 input 2)
         21 for NOT(input 2), 26 for AND, 27 for OR, 28 for XOR
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

`Awvey53G0igg/ASM_manual/pa2wvey35GPaG0vey50G0iG2k/pa2wveyG?STDOUT$a p47Gyy@0yy@0yy@0yy@0
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[ASM_usage] 
__<space>word to set flags, and __word to use it, 
only support one blank line between codes, 
use ;;<space>sentence as comments, 
if just comment in line, no space before comments, if after code, code<space>;;<space>comment
only support tabs for indentation, only support mov register,number, 
so if you need mov rax,rbx , you write mov rax,0000 add rax,rbx,
dmov and dout is supported now for decimal, it will convert d to b and store, so you can dmov and out, its ok
use dmov <register>,d<number> to use dmov
__<space>start and end must be set.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STDOUT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
please write asm below here,
46G$yy@0 							
80GAyou didnt resetyy@0     yy@0 here to run

__ start

;; this is comment

dmov rax,d1 ;; store d numbers
dmov rbx,d1 ;; this is comment
mov rcx,000000001010 ;; regular mov

mov rex,现在开始计算斐波那契 ;; everything is a string because its vim, a text editer
;; so actually you can just store string into regesters, no one cares if you dont put them in alu

out rex

dout rax
__ loop ;; you can add comment after flags it doesn't matter

	dout rax

	dmov rdx,d0
	add rdx,rax

	add rax,rbx

	mov rbx,000000000000 ;; you can still use bin if you like
	add rbx,rdx

	mov rdx,000000000001
	sub rcx,rdx

	jnc __loop ;; jump back
end

dmov rbx,d100 ;; this wont be ran, and we dont care
dout rbx
end
